save_checkpoint_model: save a PyTorch model checkpoint with optimizer state, epoch, args, and validation metrics to disk
resume_checkpoint_training: resume training from the last checkpoint by loading model and optimizer state from checkpoint.pth
save_custom_filename_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with a custom filename instead of the default epoch-based naming convention
check_resume_availability: check if a checkpoint directory and checkpoint file exist before attempting to resume training
load_best_val_metrics: load the best validation metrics from a saved checkpoint when resuming training
